texts.zh:
经过缜密研究之后，[Root.GetName]的成员探测到了一个“微弱”的回声正在从[From.GetName]的地底深处传来。

这种回声有点像是生命体发出的。可是我们与它的距离实在是太远了，很难分辨它是真的，还是只是一台发出随机信号的设备。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]的手下一直在抱怨说自己得不到适当的休息，工作时间又太长，自己再也受不了了。
texts.en:
After rigorous research, the crew of [Root.GetName] has only been able to detect a faint "echo" emanating deep beneath the surface of [From.GetName].

The echo resembles a life signature, however it is so distant it is hard to tell if it is real or just the instruments giving off random variations. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName]'s crew is complaining about bad rest and long hours and cannot take much more.

label.zh: 校正探测仪，再好好看看星球的内核！
label.en: Calibrate the scanners and look closer to the core!

label.zh: “我们不能相信这些船员。我们需要一次实地考察！”
label.en: "The crew cannot be trusted. An expedition is needed!"

label.zh: 船员的健康是第一位的。
在弄清楚之前，我们绝不能停下！
label.en: We cannot rest until we get to the bottom of this!

texts.zh:
尽管大家都筋疲力尽了，但是在调整了舰船的探测仪后，[Root.GetName]的船员和科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]得到了一个惊人的发现。在[From.From.GetName]的内核附近，有一种类似于浮游生物的生命体。它们分布于整个[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]，有着共同的意识，以及强大的灵能能力。

这种生命体能够在极高的压力和温度下存活，甚至可以以极高的速率进行繁衍。它看起来像是在冬眠……或者是在躲避什么东西，就好像它知道自己正在被观测一样。

对于如此巨大而拥有诸多优势的生命体，理论上来说它是永生的。不过，它看起来并不会妨碍我们对[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]进行殖民。但是它可能会对上面的居民产生一些负面影响。
texts.en:
After doing some adjustments to the ship scanners, the crew of [Root.GetName] and Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName], although exhausted and on edge, have made a startling discovery. Close to the core of [From.From.GetName] is a plankton-like lifeform that stretches across the entire [From.From.GetPlanetMoon], living in a shared consciousness with vast psionic abilities.

The lifeform is able to survive under both extreme pressures and temperatures. It can even expand itself at rapid rates. It seem to either be hibernating or... hiding, as if it knew it was being watched.

A lifeform this vast in size and versatile seems technically immortal. However it does not seem like it would hinder us to colonize the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon], but it might have a negative influence on the population.

label.zh: 我们应该试着去和它接触。
label.en: We should try and contact it.

label.zh: 我们可以向海中下毒并杀死它。
label.en: We could poison the ocean to kill it.

texts.zh:
在多次尝试接触而没有结果后，我们的小队决定尝试用声波进行联系。声波使那个生物产生了巨大的反应，所有的小队成员都双膝跪地，陷入了栩栩如生的幻象之中。

这好像是这种生物的主要交流方式。它描述了它的母星，它静静地躺在星核附近，沐浴在[From.From.From.GetPlanetMoon]的温暖之中，在黑暗中繁衍。然后它向我们展示了我们的人民站在地表上，在阳光中繁衍壮大。
texts.en:
After trying several methods of contact without an answer the team decides to try sonar pings. The sound waves cause a massive reaction in the being and every crew member falls to their knees, struck with vivid visions.

This seems to be the creatures' main form of communication. It depicts its homeworld, where it lies alone near the core basking in the warmth of the [From.From.From.GetPlanetMoon], thriving in the darkness. Then it shows our people, standing on the surface, thriving in the sunshine.

label.zh: 我们很乐意接受这份邀请。

tooltips.zh: 你的帝国获得了负面媒体报道修正效果。
tooltips.en: Your Empire gains the Negative Media Coverage modifier.

texts.zh:
科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]很快就合成出了一种毒药，它应该会和这个生物的内在结构产生剧烈的反应，以野火之势扩散开来。

在释放了毒药之后，船员们陷入到了极大的恐惧之中。他们目睹了一个史无前例的事件。[From.From.From.GetName]的内核温度急剧升高，导致整个海洋沸腾。生命体那巨大的躯体也开始向大气中释放毒素。这个浮游生物般的东西对于[From.From.From.GetPlanetMoon]那不稳定的核心来说一定是至关重要的。这种毒素应该也是它在进化中得到的一种自我防御的机制。

[From.From.From.GetPlanetMoon]在几个小时之内就充满了剧毒。
texts.en:
Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] quickly synthesizes a poison that should react well with the creature's interconnected form and spread like wildfire.

After releasing the poison the crew stare in horror as they bear witness to an unprecedented event. [From.From.From.GetName]'s core temperature spirals out of control which causes the oceans to boil. The creature's gargantuan body also releases toxins into the atmosphere. The plankton entity must have been vital in the regulation of the [From.From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s unstable center, as well as developed toxic defense mechanisms in order to protect itself.

The [From.From.From.GetPlanetMoon] becomes completely toxic in a matter of hours.

texts.zh:
由于怀疑这些船员想要隐瞒什么，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]决定发起一场不经批准的单枪匹马的探险，以仔细检查星球的内核。船上潜艇的摄像机传回了录像带，记录了事情的经过：

深入[From.From.GetName]的海洋，那里只有黑暗。但是，还有一些……活着的东西。在[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]温暖的内核附近有一些深海洞穴。洞穴的里面有网状的、类似于浮游生物的植被，缠绕着[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]的整个地壳。

在调查浮游生物的时候，[Root.GetLeaderName]突然癫痫发作，在几个小时之后才醒过来。

回到[Root.GetName]后，科学专员神志不清，一直在诉说一些关于恐惧和邪恶幻境的事情。
texts.en:
Suspicious that the crew is hiding something, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] decided to mount an unauthorized solo-expedition to examine the planet's core. A video feed from the ships submarine shows what happened:

Going deep into the oceans of [From.From.GetName] there is only darkness, but also something... alive. Inside deep-sea caverns close to the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s warm core there are webs of plankton-like vegetation, that spans the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s entire crust.

While investigating the plankton [Root.GetLeaderName] is stricken with a seizure, only to awake hours later.

After returning to the [Root.GetName] the Science Officer is delusional and only speaks of horrors and haunted visions.

label.zh: 科学专员也许只是太累了。
label.en: The Science Officer probably just needs rest.

[From.From.From.GetName]的那次事件过去一个星期后，[Root.GetName]的船员被一声惊尖叫惊扰。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]大喊大叫，在船上横冲直撞，说自己感到很痛很痛。

船员们把他带到医务室给他打了大量镇定剂并仔细检查后确认[Root.GetLeaderName]的大脑发生了改变。

详细的检查最终发现这位领袖现在拥有了心灵感应能力，能够通过精神跟他人沟通。[Root.GetLeaderName]经过休息后会康复的。
texts.en:
It has been a week since the incident on [From.From.From.GetName] when the crew of the [Root.GetName] are disturbed by a loud scream. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is yelling, running through the halls of the ship, going on about inexplicable pains.

The crew brings the poor scientist to the sickbay and after heavy sedation and a thorough examination concludes that [Root.GetLeaderName]'s brain has changed.

After further tests the team startlingly realizes that their leader is now capable of telekinesis and communicating with others via telepathy. [Root.GetLeaderName] is going to get healthy, after some rest.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]的船员结束了他们的[From.From.GetName]研究，终于能够休息整顿了。可惜他们并没有什么重大收获，但是他们受到的良好待遇很快传开了，在母星深获好评。足够的休息确保了船员们能够在未来取得更好的结果。
texts.en: The [Root.GetName]'s crew ends their research of [From.From.GetName], thankful of finally getting some rest. Sadly there were not any useful finds, but news of the crew being well-treated spreads fast and brings forth many a good word on our homeworld. Being well-rested should also have the crew produce even better results in the long run.

texts.zh:
夜以继日地研究回声的根源后，[Root.GetName]发现了[From.From.GetName]地面下生活的一种生物。之前没有发觉是因为它生活在非常靠近[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]核心的地方，这导致我们的系统分析对它毫无效用。

通过扫描我们发现它是尚处于进化早期阶段的海洋节肢动物，但最神奇的是它竟然能够将死去的生物物质改造成自己的后代。

这个信息非常有助于我们的科学家开发新的药物！不过，我们对待我们的人员的方式肯定会传播出去，造成不良影响。
texts.en:
After working day and night in order to find the reason behind the echo, the crew of [Root.GetName] have found an interesting lifeform living underneath the surface of [From.From.GetName]. Previously we could not detect it due to its amazing ability to live so close to the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s core, throwing off our systems analytics.

Scans show it to be a type of aquatic arthropod early in its evolution, but what is most surprising is the fact that it is able to reproduce by repurposing dead matter from other lifeforms into offspring.

This information will surely help our scientists to develop new pharmaceuticals! However, news of how we treated our personnel will surely spread and displease the general populace.

summary.text:
# 沧海一粟 / Drops in the Ocean

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration (C3)

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 3级异常；在海洋行星上以权重3生成，仅限非格式塔且未持禁止干涉政策的帝国。  
  Level-3 anomaly; spawn weight 3 on ocean planets for non-gestalt empires without the interference_not_allowed policy.
- 约30天后另有一份通用联络报告（story.1–8，共享枢纽故事），不属于本故事。  
  About 30 days later a generic contact report (story.1–8, a shared hub story) follows; it is not part of this story.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 4045“深处的回声”：海底深处的微弱“回声”，船员疲惫。选项取决于科学家特质：  
  4045 "Echoes from the Deep": a faint echo far below; the crew is exhausted. Options depend on the scientist:
- 细致或天才火花的科学家：校准扫描仪 → 4046 发现覆盖全球、具灵能的浮游意识（行星获“远古之物”资源点与敌对环境，负面舆论）。可尝试接触 → 4047（接受“邀请”，敌对环境移除）；下毒 → 4048（行星变为有毒世界，+4社会学）；或不予理会。  
  Meticulous or spark-of-genius scientist: recalibrate → 4046 a planet-wide psionic plankton mind (Ancient One deposit, hostile environment, negative press). Contact it → 4047 (an "invitation"; hostile environment removed), poison it → 4048 (planet turns toxic, +4 society), or leave it.
- 偏执的科学家：私自下潜 → 4049 科学家获得“狂躁”特质；让其休息 → 7天后 4050 获得灵能专长；或关押（科学家被移除）。  
  Paranoid scientist: an unauthorised dive → 4049 (Maniacal trait); let them rest → 4050 after 7 days (psionics expertise), or confine them (the scientist is removed).
- 任何科学家：船员健康优先 → 4051（正面舆论、休息良好修正，首次解锁“改善工作环境”法令）；或不眠不休 → 4052（发现新的海底节肢生物，医药创新修正，负面舆论）。  
  Any scientist: crew health first → 4051 (positive press, Well Rested Scientists; unlocks the Improved Working Environment edict the first time); or push on → 4052 (a new arthropod; Pharmaceutical Innovation, negative press).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 结局由选择决定，没有随机分支。  
  Outcomes follow the choices; there is no random branch.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无特别差异。  
  No notable variants.
